findings.title: Your server turns bots away even though robots.txt allows them
findings.detail: robots.txt is only a declaration. When we requested the page identifying as these bots, the server refused or returned far less content than it gives a browser. This is usually a WAF, Cloudflare bot-fight mode, or rate limiting.
